title: SearchRequest
description: Request payload for the verana-graph faceted-search endpoint `POST /v4/graph/search` (per [TG-FCT-1] through [TG-FCT-7]). Filter field names use the dotted form from [TG-FCT-3] / [TG-FCT-4]. Filter values are either bare scalars (interpreted as `eq`) or operator objects (`{ eq | in | range | prefix | contains | containsAny }`). Per [TG-FCT-7] pagination is cursor-based; offset-based pagination MUST NOT be used. See `### Search REST binding` in the verana-graph spec.

surface.description: Searchable result surface per [TG-FCT-1]. Exactly one surface per request.

filters.description: Structured filters keyed by dotted field names from [TG-FCT-3] (e.g. `Did.operatorKind`, `OrganizationCredential.legalJurisdiction`, `Participant.role`). Each value MUST validate against `#/$defs/FilterValue`. Free-form because field names span multiple ECS schemas; per-surface field-name validity is documented in the spec, not enforced by this schema.

freeText.description: Free-form lexical query string. Scored against the fields enumerated in [TG-FCT-4].

limit.description: Maximum number of hits to return on this page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response per [TG-FCT-7]. Omit (or set `null`) for the first page.

includeUntrusted.description: Override the [TG-FCT-2] default `Did.trusted = true` gate. Has no effect on non-`Did` surfaces. The `Did.expiresAtTime` (null OR `>= now`) and trust-expired-controller gates of [TG-FCT-2] are NOT overridable, regardless of this flag.

includeArchived.description: Override the [TG-FCT-2] default `archived = false` gate on `Ecosystem` and `CredentialSchema` surfaces. Has no effect on other surfaces.

Scalar.description: anyOf, not oneOf: a JSON integer matches both `number` and `integer`, so a oneOf over both branches rejects every integer.

FilterValue.description: A bare scalar (interpreted as `eq`) or an operator object. Operators map to the [TG-FCT-3] operator column; not every operator applies to every field — spec text governs which operators are valid per field.

in.description: Match any of the listed values.

range.description: Numeric / temporal range. At least one bound MUST be provided.

contains.description: Set / array containment of a single value.

containsAny.description: Set / array containment of any value in the list.
